citations.narrative:
The facility failed to collect the required samples at 48-hour intervals after a coliform sample collected from the Medical
Pool on April 30, 2026, exceeded 1,000 MPN per 100 ml of water. Facility personnel stated the follow-up samples were
not collected because testing supplies were unavailable.
Failure to collect the required follow-up samples prevents verification that corrective actions restored the water quality to
acceptable levels for the marine mammals,
When coliform levels exceed 1,000 MPN per 100 ml of water, two subsequent samples must be collected at 48-hour
intervals and averaged with the first sample. If such average count does not fall below 1000 MPN, then the water in the
pool shall be deemed unsatisfactory. To be corrected from this day, July 7, 2026, forward.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
Additional Inspectors:
Kelly Helmick, Senior Veterinary Medical Officer n
